name: wakeflow
description: A disciplined control loop for multi-window Codex workspaces, aligned with Wakeflow's Claude Code edition: a controller window plans, dispatches scoped task packages, collects immutable target results, obtains independent Test validation, reviews the evidence, and decides the next step. Explicit state roots keep the run auditable; evidence alone does not close a task.

interface.shortDescription: Dual-host control loops for agent work
interface.longDescription: Wakeflow ships Codex and Claude Code editions for the same local-first control model. This Codex artifact packages controller state roots, task packages, Design/Test intake, delivery envelopes, immutable TargetResult records, review reducers, controller-return envelopes, two localized demand-progress assets, verification scripts, and controller/target skills for Codex workspaces. It coordinates unattended workflows without secretly sending prompts or replacing independent Test validation or controller judgment, and can share demand state with the Claude Code edition in dual-host workspaces.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the current workspace with Wakeflow
